window.dataLayer || [];
window.__haugastolConsentState = { analytics: false, marketing: false };
window.gtag = window.gtag || function(){window.dataLayer.push(arguments);};
window.gtag('consent', 'default', {
  'analytics_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_storage': 'denied',
  'ad_user_data': 'denied',
  'ad_personalization': 'denied',
  'wait_for_update': 500
});
window.dataLayer.push({ event: 'consent_default_denied' });
(function(){
  function clearCookies(prefixes) {
    var hostname = window.location.hostname;
    var labels = hostname.split('.');
    var parentDomain = labels.length > 2 ? '.' + labels.slice(-2).join('.') : '';
    var domains = ['', hostname, '.' + hostname, parentDomain];
    var names = document.cookie.split(';').map(function(part) {
      return decodeURIComponent((part.split('=')[0] || '').trim());
    });
    names.forEach(function(name) {
      if (!name || !prefixes.some(function(prefix) {
        return name === prefix || name.indexOf(prefix) === 0;
      })) return;
      domains.forEach(function(domain) {
        var domainPart = domain ? '; Domain=' + domain : '';
        document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(name) + '=; Max-Age=0; Path=/' + domainPart + '; SameSite=Lax';
      });
    });
  }
  try {
    var raw = window.localStorage.getItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
    if (!raw) return;
    var stored = JSON.parse(raw);
    var valid =
      stored &&
      stored.version === 2 &&
      stored.policyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      stored.copyVersion === "2026-10-05" &&
      typeof stored.receiptId === 'string' &&
      stored.receiptId.length >= 16 &&
      typeof stored.createdAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.createdAt) &&
      typeof stored.updatedAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.updatedAt) &&
      typeof stored.expiresAt === 'number' &&
      Number.isFinite(stored.expiresAt) &&
      stored.expiresAt > Date.now() &&
      stored.necessary === true &&
      typeof stored.analytics === 'boolean' &&
      typeof stored.marketing === 'boolean';
    if (!valid) {
      window.localStorage.removeItem("haugastol_consent_v2");
      return;
    }
    if (!stored.analytics) clearCookies(['_ga', '_gid', '_gat']);
    if (!stored.marketing) clearCookies(['_gcl_', '_gac_', '_fbp', '_fbc']);
    var restored = {
      analytics_storage: stored.analytics ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_storage: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_user_data: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied',
      ad_personalization: stored.marketing ? 'granted' : 'denied'
    };
    window.__haugastolConsentState = {
      analytics: stored.analytics,
      marketing: stored.marketing
    };
    window.gtag('consent', 'update', restored);
    window.dataLayer.push({
      event: 'consent_restored',
      consent_analytics: stored.analytics,
      consent_marketing: stored.marketing,
      consent_version: 'v2'
    });
  } catch (_) {}

md:text-[5.35rem] lg:text-[6.1rem]">Food &amp; drink</h1><p class="max-w-2xl text-base text-white/90 md:text-[1.18rem]">A calm meal experience with local ingredients, international inspiration, and a md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_320px]"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Dinner tonight</h2><ul class="mt-4 space-y-2 text-[#4a453f]"><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span aria-hidden="true">•</span><span>New two-course menu every evening.</span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span aria-hidden="true">•</span><span>Self-serve in a calm setting.</span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span aria-hidden="true">•</span><span>Local ingredients with international kitchen inspiration.</span></li><li class="flex items-start gap-2"><span aria-hidden="true">•</span><span>Stone-oven pizza: every day in July and August, 13:00–20:00. No pre-booking required.</span></li></ul><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">Two-course dinner is served at 19:00 in summer</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Dinner is served at 19:00 in summer, not from 19:00. Rallar package guests have table seating at 20:15 on day 2.</p></article><aside class="space-y-3"><a class="booking-cta-on-light inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center border border-[#1d1916] bg-[#1d1916] px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white" style="color:#fff" href="/en/booking">Add meals to booking</a><a href="mailto:mail@haugastol.no" class="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center border border-[#1d1916] bg-white px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#1d1916]">Contact us about allergens</a><a class="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center border border-[#1d1916] bg-white px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#1d1916]" href="/en/self-service">See opening periods</a></aside></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 -mt-2 pb-6 md:-mt-4 md:pb-8"><a class="flex flex-col gap-3 border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-6 transition hover:border-[#c9bfb0] md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between md:p-7" href="/en/pizza"><div class="max-w-2xl"><h2 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-3xl">Pizza in July and August</h2><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Daily 13:00–20:00. No table reservation.</p></div><span class="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center border border-[#1d1916] bg-white px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-[#1d1916]">See menu</span></a></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-2 md:py-6"><h2 class="mb-5 text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">How it works</h2><div class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-3"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">1) Pre-book meals</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Meals must be booked at least 2 days before arrival.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">2) Tell us about allergens</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Share allergies and dietary needs in advance so we can plan safely.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-5"><h3 class="text-2xl font-medium text-[#1d1916]">3) Enjoy dinner</h3><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Two courses are served in a self-serve format in a warm, calm setting.</p></article></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-2 md:py-6"><div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Local ingredients, international kitchen</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">We use local ingredients whenever possible, and work with flavors from several kitchen traditions. The result is grounded, varied and clear.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Two courses, new menu every evening</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">Dinner follows a simple two-course structure. The menu changes from evening to evening based on season and ingredient availability.</p></article></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-4 md:py-6"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-[#faf8f3] p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-3xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-4xl">Breakfast + packed lunch</h2><p class="mt-3 text-[#4a453f]">Breakfast is served between 08:00 and 10:00 during full-service periods.</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">You can prepare a packed lunch from breakfast for an additional fee.</p><p class="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-[#5a5148]">Add-on: NOK 22 per slice</p></article></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-10 md:py-14"><div class="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Practical rules</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">Meals must be pre-booked at least 2 days before arrival. Exception: stone-oven pizza (daily in July and August, 13:00–20:00) does not require pre-booking. Dinner for staying guests NOK 490, breakfast NOK 210 (separate prices for children).</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Cabin guests and other non-resident guests can book the two-course dinner on most days by calling booking at least 2 days in advance. When capacity is limited, resident guests are prioritized.</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Dinner cancellations for non-resident guests must be made at least 48 hours before arrival. For staying guests, the accommodation cancellation deadlines apply.</p></article><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Allergens and dietary needs</h2><p class="mt-4 text-[#4a453f]">We need information about allergens and dietary needs in advance. For allergens, vegetarian or vegan meals, add a note in the message field when you book.</p><div class="mt-5"><a href="mailto:mail@haugastol.no" class="inline-flex items-center justify-center border border-[#1d1916] bg-[#1d1916] px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-white" style="color:#fff">Contact us about allergens</a></div></article></div></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-4 md:py-8"><article class="border border-[#ddd5c8] bg-white p-6 md:p-7"><h2 class="text-3xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-4xl">Seasons and availability</h2><p class="mt-3 text-[#4a453f]">Restaurant service in summer season (27 June–19 September).</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">Shoulder season applies from 20 September until the start of February 2027. During self-service periods, restaurant service is not available.</p><p class="mt-2 text-[#4a453f]">What is shown in our online booking for your chosen dates is what applies.</p></article></section><section class="mx-auto w-full max-w-[1240px] px-6 py-10 md:py-14"><h2 class="mb-5 text-4xl font-medium text-[#1d1916] md:text-5xl">Curated guest quotes</h2><p
